title: Your people
summary: People shows everyone Kumo keeps a page on, by circle in your order: Mira, then your friends, then work, then Others. Each has their Contacts photo, when you last saw them, from the calendar and your journal, and what's coming up: Mira's birthday, tonight's run with Leo. Omar's page brings his card's facts for the one-tap actions, what Kumo knows, your moments together from the journal and the places you share. You move Family above Friends and add Five-a-side, and the circles follow.
